Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_PositiveCostMultipl: Multiplies a positive trait's creation-point cost. Prices round up to whole Tokens. Default: 1.0.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_NegativeCostMultipl: Multiplies a negative trait's absolute creation-point value. Removal prices round up to whole Tokens. Default: 2.0.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_AllowNegativeRemova: Allows spending Tokens to remove supported negative traits. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_RewardMode_tooltip: Select which sources can award XP. Hybrid is the standalone default; Horde Night is the default when OMH: Horde Night is active. Horde rewards arrive in a future update.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_HordeZombieXP_toolt: Reserved for the OMH: Horde Night integration in a future update. Does not award XP in this build.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_PlayerKillXP_toolti: XP per enemy player killed outside your faction. Factionless players qualify. Same-account and self kills do not. Multiplayer only. Zero disables this reward.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_DayXP_tooltip: XP for surviving a full connected day from seasonal dawn to dusk. Uses the game day/night cycle, not the Horde Night schedule. Sleep and fast-forward count. A partial period after joining or reconnecting does not qualify. Endless day/night has no completed periods. Zero disables this reward.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_ZombieXP_tooltip: XP per ordinary zombie killed. Zero disables this reward. Tagged Horde Night zombies are reserved for horde rewards.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_HordeSurvivedXP_too: Reserved for the OMH: Horde Night integration in a future update. Does not award XP in this build.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_PlayerKillCooldownD: In-game days before the same victim can reward XP again. Tracked by server account pair across deaths, reconnects and restarts. Default: 2. Changing this affects future rewarded kills; existing cooldowns keep their expiry.
Sandbox_OMHTraitShop_NightXP_tooltip: XP for surviving a full connected night from seasonal dusk to dawn. Uses the game day/night cycle, not the Horde Night schedule. Sleep and fast-forward count. A partial period after joining or reconnecting does not qualify. Endless day/night has no completed periods. Zero disables this reward.
